# Rongorongo Barthel-Format Corpus
# Based on the standard Barthel (1958) transcription system
# Each glyph represented as 3-digit Barthel number
# Compounds as hyphenated sequences (e.g., 200-300)
# Reverse boustrophedon: odd lines L→R, even lines R→L
# Tablet markers: >TabletName (side)
# ============================================================
